result.instructions: Tools for Koban, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the Koban account for 'Dupont SARL' and list its open deals."; "Which leads are in status MQL right now?"; "List the actions assigned to me for this week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Koban data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run koban_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run koban_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run koban_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. koban_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: koban_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the Koban account (login, name, active state). Use it to find the user id for assignments. Koban API: GET /ncAuthenticate/GetUsers.

tools.name: koban_search_accounts
tools.title: Search accounts
tools.description: Search Koban accounts (companies and persons) by label. Returns matching accounts with status, type and assignment. Koban API: GET /ncThird/GetByLabel.

search.description: Text to find in the account label.

tools.name: koban_get_account
tools.title: Get an account
tools.description: Get one Koban account by its id, including address, status, type, tags and custom fields. Koban API: GET /ncThird/GetOne.

id.description: The Koban object id (GUID, from a list or get tool).

tools.name: koban_get_account_by_external_code
tools.title: Get an account by external code
tools.description: Get one Koban account by your own external code (Extcode). Use it when your system stores the Koban link by external code. Koban API: GET /ncThird/GetOneByExtcode.

extcode.description: Your own external code for the record (Koban Extcode).

annotations.title: Get an account by external code

tools.name: koban_list_updated_accounts
tools.title: List updated accounts
tools.description: List accounts changed after a Unix time, one page at a time. Use it for incremental sync. Koban API: GET /ncThird/GetUpdated.

updated.description: Unix time in seconds. Only records changed after this time are returned (example: 1555008374).

structcode.description: Only accounts of this structure code (optional).

limit.description: Records per page (the vendor examples use 20).

tools.name: koban_upsert_account
tools.title: Create or update an account
tools.description: Create an account, or update the account that has this external code. Existing fields not sent are kept. Koban API: POST /ncThird/PostOne with uniqueproperty=Extcode.

extcode.description: Your own external code for the record (Koban Extcode).

label.description: The account name (company name or person name).

status_code.description: The account status code (for example CLI for a client).

type_code.description: The account type code (for example PRO or PER).

tools.name: koban_upsert_contact
tools.title: Create or update a contact
tools.description: Create a contact, or update the contact that has this external code. Optionally link it to an account by the account's external code. Koban API: POST /ncContact/PostOne.

extcode.description: Your own external code for the record (Koban Extcode).

account_extcode.description: External code of the account to link the contact to.

tools.name: koban_create_action
tools.title: Create an action
tools.description: Create a new action (task, call or meeting) for a user, linked to an account or a deal. Each call creates a new action; a retry creates a duplicate. Koban API: POST /ncAction/Post.

status_code.description: The action status code from your Koban settings (for example NDEM).

assigned_to_guid.description: The user id (GUID) the action is assigned to.

account_guid.description: The account id (GUID) to link the action to.

account_extcode.description: The account external code, if no account id is given.

deal_guid.description: The deal id (GUID) to link the action to.
